exposure: time to ambulation after spinal anesthesia
cohort: 292 obstetric patients at Santokba Durlabhji Memorial Hospital, Jaipur, Rajasthan from August 2017 to November 2020.
finding: The incidence of PSPH was 39.72%, and was associated with lower BMI, multiple dural puncture attempts, puncture at L3-4, delayed ambulation, cutting needle, CSF leakage, higher intraoperative blood loss, prior chronic headache, and weak opioid analgesia.
